asked.item: Did uploading my own photos use credits?
Did writing my own caption use credits?

verdict.reason: The pages say uploading your own images and drafting text do not use credits, and they say where to check the balance.

steps.text: Uploading your own images or videos does not use credits.
quotes: Uploading your own images or videos

steps.text: Drafting text does not use credits either.
quotes: Uploading your own image and drafting text do not.

steps.text: To check your balance, go to Settings > Billing.
quotes: To check your balance, go to Settings > Billing.
